page.overview:
What is Unidentified planet?

A remote uninhabited planet was located beyond the Outer Rim Territories. Around the Galactic Civil War, Darth Vader overheard Graballa the Hutt informing Vader that he had captured Rowan Freemaker at the former Freemaker garage. Later M-OC questioned Vader about the location of Rowan, Vader tricked him and sent him to this remote planet.
